c74object.name: bachmcp.algo.transform
c74object.digest: Transform a score with an algorithm
c74object.description: Runs an algorithm written by the model (or by hand) on a score. Scores come in and go out as dict (bachjson); use bachmcp.translate to and from bach.roll. With source_mode 1 it holds the score it received and every output starts again from it. With source_mode 0 every score it receives replaces the source, and is transformed by the next bang or parameter change.

inlet.digest: dictionary, bang, param, source_mode, auto_dump, name, write, open

outlet.digest: Asks for a score: connect to bach.roll (through bachmcp.translate)

objarg.name: name
objarg.description: The name the model and the server know this instance by. Unique in the patch.

method.name: dictionary
method.description: A score as a dictionary. With source_mode 1 the first one becomes the source; with source_mode 0 each one becomes the source, without being transformed.

method.name: bang
method.description: Transforms the source with the current parameters and outputs it.

method.name: param
method.description: Sets a parameter of the algorithm, e.g. param shift 700. Pitch parameters also take note names.

attribute.name: source_mode
attribute.description: 1: the first score received is the source; every output starts again from it. 0: every score received becomes the source; after an output, parameter changes wait (up to 3 s) for the next score to come back.

attribute.name: auto_dump
attribute.description: 1: every parameter change outputs a score. 0: only bang does.
